notes.title: Demo Update 1.01
notes.content:
Demo Patch 1.01 Update

- Fixed a bug where the relics "Squire's Shield" and "Beginner's Belt" would not grant a stat boost to the battle right after they are equipped.
- Rebalanced booster pack item rates
- Fixed a bug where controller keycaps were shown while using keyboard controls.
- Increased the appearance rate of a rare achievement event when you have cleared both demo paths.
